newsitem.title: PERU: Nine feared dead as boat overturns off Peru coast.
newsitem.headline: Nine feared dead as boat overturns off Peru coast.

text.p: Nine people, including four children, were feared drowned after an excursion boat overturned in rough seas off Peru's southern coast, authorities said on Sunday.
"We found the boat upside down and clothes floating on the surface of the water," a firefighter in Pisco port, 150 miles (240 kms) south of Lima, told Reuters.

The "Zodiac," carrying members of three families, left Mendieta beach 25 miles (40 kms) south of Pisco on Saturday morning without approval of the port captaincy and headed for a Pacific coastal area known as Laguna Grande, he said.
"It's an area of rough seas and fog," the firefighter said.
Peru's Coast Guard and firefighters discovered the overturned boat at about 3 p.m. (2000 GMT) on Saturday and search and rescue efforts were called off when darkness fell.
Weather permitting, the Coast Guard would resume the search at 5:30 a.m., he said.
The children aboard the boat ranged in age three to 16.
